controls.title: Access Control Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate access control policy and procedures applicable to the information system for state government data.

controls.title: Account Management
controls.description: Manage information system accounts including establishing, activating, modifying, reviewing, disabling, and removing accounts for state government data systems.

controls.title: Access Enforcement
controls.description: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to state government information and system resources.

controls.title: Unsuccessful Logon Attempts
controls.description: Enforce a limit of consecutive invalid logon attempts and automatically lock the account for a defined time period.

controls.title: System Use Notification
controls.description: Display a system use notification message before granting access that provides privacy and security notices.

controls.title: Remote Access
controls.description: Establish, document, authorize, monitor, and control remote access methods to the information system.

controls.title: Use of External Information Systems
controls.description: Establish terms and conditions for use of external information systems to access state government data.

controls.title: Security Awareness and Training Policy
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate security awareness and training policy to applicable personnel.

controls.title: Security Awareness Training
controls.description: Provide basic security awareness training to information system users as part of initial training and annually thereafter.

controls.title: Audit and Accountability Policy
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate audit and accountability policy applicable to the information system.

controls.title: Audit Events
controls.description: Determine that the information system is capable of auditing defined events and coordinate the security audit function.

controls.title: Audit Review, Analysis, and Reporting
controls.description: Review and analyze information system audit records for indications of inappropriate or unusual activity and report findings.

controls.title: Security Assessment Policy
controls.description: Develop and disseminate a security assessment and authorization policy and procedures.

controls.title: Security Assessments
controls.description: Assess the security controls in the information system to determine the extent to which the controls are implemented correctly and operating as intended.

controls.title: System Interconnections
controls.description: Authorize connections from the information system to other information systems through the use of Interconnection Security Agreements.

controls.title: Configuration Management Policy
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate configuration management policy and procedures.

controls.title: Baseline Configuration
controls.description: Develop, document, and maintain a current baseline configuration of the information system.

controls.title: Configuration Settings
controls.description: Establish and document configuration settings for information technology products employed within the information system.

controls.title: Contingency Planning Policy
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate a contingency planning policy and procedures.

controls.title: Information System Backup
controls.description: Conduct backups of user-level and system-level information contained in the information system at defined frequencies.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication Policy
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate identification and authentication policy and procedures.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users)
controls.description: Uniquely identify and authenticate organizational users and implement multi-factor authentication for network access to privileged accounts.

controls.title: Incident Response Policy
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate an incident response policy and procedures.

controls.title: Incident Reporting
controls.description: Require personnel to report suspected security incidents to the organizational incident response capability and report incidents to state government entities as required.

controls.title: Media Protection Policy
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate media protection policy and procedures.

controls.title: Physical and Environmental Protection Policy
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate physical and environmental protection policy and procedures.

controls.title: Security Planning Policy
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate a security planning policy and procedures.

controls.title: Risk Assessment Policy
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate a risk assessment policy and procedures.

controls.title: Vulnerability Scanning
controls.description: Scan for vulnerabilities in the information system and hosted applications at defined frequencies and when new vulnerabilities are identified.

controls.title: System and Services Acquisition Policy
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate a system and services acquisition policy including information security considerations.

controls.title: System and Communications Protection Policy
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate system and communications protection policy and procedures.

controls.title: Boundary Protection
controls.description: Monitor and control communications at the external boundary and at key internal boundaries of the information system.

controls.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
controls.description: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted information using cryptographic mechanisms.

controls.title: Protection of Information at Rest
controls.description: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of state government information at rest.

controls.title: System and Information Integrity Policy
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate system and information integrity policy and procedures.

controls.title: Flaw Remediation
controls.description: Identify, report, and correct information system flaws in a timely manner.

controls.title: Malicious Code Protection
controls.description: Implement malicious code protection mechanisms at entry and exit points and at workstations, servers, or mobile devices.

controls.title: Information System Monitoring
controls.description: Monitor the information system to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks and unauthorized connections.
